editorial:
Imagine being so stuck in your life that you would pretend to be blind just to get a plane ticket. That is exactly what Hassan does. He is a security guard in Egypt who feels like he has no future, so he comes up with a wild plan to join the national blind soccer team. Since the team is heading to the World Cup in Poland, it is his golden ticket to Europe. The vibe is a great mix of a stressful heist movie and a goofy comedy. You will find yourself rooting for Hassan even though he is technically lying to everyone around him.

The acting is top-notch and makes the whole lie feel believable. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the drama gets a bit heavy toward the end. If you like stories about underdogs and risky bets, you will love this.
endingExplained: At the end, Hassan's lie finally catches up with him. He is exposed as a fraud right when he thinks he has made it. Instead of a happy ending where he just escapes, the movie shows the guilt he feels for betraying his teammates. He realizes that the bonds he made with the blind players were the only real things in his life. He ends up facing the consequences of his actions but finds a sense of peace and honesty.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories and dark comedies.
